path_attestation.component_path_rule: GetComponentPath formats GetPath + '/' + GetName. Both SceneManagerDebugComponent and Director DebugComponent inherit empty GetPath; their GetName returns Scene manager and Camera respectively.
path_attestation.scene_manager_prefix: GetComponentPath -> /Scene manager; ungrouped RegisterVariable uses that component path, then VariableManager attaches the variable leaf. Alias prefix is exactly /Scene manager.
path_attestation.director_prefix: GetComponentPath -> /Camera; MakeFullPath appends the literal group, then VariableManager attaches the leaf. Empty group normalizes through CreateMenuPath to /Camera/<leaf>.
path_attestation.shadow_prefix: ShadowMap::Construct uses DebugInterface::RegisterVariable with literal World\\ShadowMap; DebugInterface forwards the literal path to VariableManager at the root, and MenuManager accepts both slash and backslash delimiters. No component selector is used.
path_attestation.raw_alias_paths: The slash-normalized full paths in raw_readback_path are the exact paths to define/read. Scene Manager aliases select component Scene manager; Director aliases select component Camera; Shadow aliases use the literal root path.
